description.value: Andreas Restaurant is a family-owned North Vancouver institution open since 1984, run by father-and-son duo Andreas and Dimitrios, with a scratch kitchen that hand-makes an extensive menu of over 130 items — from Greek specialties to pizza, pasta, steaks, and seafood — every morning. The restaurant explicitly welcomes tour groups with specially crafted group menus and offers free delivery across North Vancouver, West Vancouver, and Deep Cove. A long-standing local favourite, it sends guests home with complimentary fresh-baked bread as a nod to the founder's original tradition.
